❌ Stop randomly practicing SQL questions hoping to crack MNC interviews.
✅ Instead, focus on what actually gets asked — with a twist.
Here are the Top SQL Questions MNCs Love to Ask 👇
🔹 Basic Level
✔️ What are the key differences between SQL and NoSQL databases?
✔️ Explain different types of SQL joins with examples.
✔️ What’s the difference between CHAR and VARCHAR?
🔸 Intermediate Level
✔️ DELETE vs TRUNCATE — what’s the real difference?
✔️ How do indexes work, and why do they matter?
✔️ What are aggregate functions in SQL? Give examples.
⚠️ Heads-up: Don’t just memorize these. MNC recruiters often twist them to test your thinking, not your memory.
